metric: Fraction of new acquisitions belonging to the top q% of the full candidate pool; initial samples excluded from numerator and denominator
cutoff: Direction-aware kth best target, k=ceil(q*N); include all candidates tied at cutoff
weighting: Average retained runs within each task, then equally average all nine tasks; do not pool the 83 filtered runs with unequal task weights
exclusion: Same seven paired runs whose shared initial set already contains the GLOBAL optimum, not all runs with initial top-q candidates
